_spec: ZetaToolStore golden vectors v1 — the IR treaty. Every oracle (TS zeta-store.ts, F# ZetaToolStore.fs, and the other 5) MUST reproduce these observable results identically, across space (7 langs) and time (DST replay). Text-only per no-binary-in-proof-lineage. This v1 locks the fs (DagFs) SEMANTICS that are hash-independent (resolve results, COW vs shared edit) — the part that already agrees. Addresses are NOT locked yet (see _convergence): the content-hash choice is the first treaty signature.
_convergence: content-hash function — TS blake3 (ace/store.ts contentHash) vs F# XxHash128 (MerkleHash.ofBytes): the content ADDRESSES diverge across oracles. The treaty must pick ONE canonical hash. Until then, vectors lock only hash-independent observables (resolve content, not the address).

editEverywhere on an ABSENT path — TS links-if-absent; F# DagFs is a no-op. F# DagFs is the source of truth → reconcile TS to no-op. (Both agree on the present-path case, which IS locked below.)
db event type — TS db_append event is an object; F# is a string. Canonicalize (a JSON string both sides) before locking db vectors.
